## Feed README

This feed is the input of one stage of the pretraining run ledger. feed_index.json lists every file; run_spec_v3_2.docx is the governing specification and governance_precedence.docx says which documents are approved. Control blocks, record counts and the record chain are defined in run_spec section 2.

Exporters differ: decimal commas, thousands separators, k and M suffixes, local wall times, epoch numbers, spreadsheet serial dates, byte order marks, cp1252 lines and restated headers all occur. They are documented in run_spec section 3 and Appendix D.
